method: Full source review plus evidence-led semantic checks: task focus, direct answers, distinct section purpose, claim consistency, source support, useful internal links and accurate CTA scope. Numerical semantic scores are not invented; arbitrary comma, word-count and link-position rules are not presented as search requirements. Integrated output/browser evidence is recorded separately.

pages.review: Preserved noindex and recovery links; canonical now identifies the actual static 404 file. Missing-path status requires production readback.

Read and retained historical September 5 observations, revision reference, reproduction steps and explicit owned-site/measurement limits. Shared publisher schema and byline apply; original publication date preserved.

Rebuilt around dated query/task comparisons, public evidence limits, content-gap decisions and verifiable actions. Removed ranking-cause guesses, word-count and authority targets, retired rich-result claims and fabricated competitive certainty.

Rebuilt as conversion measurement and experiment planning. Correct denominator and percentage-point arithmetic, illustrative example, event verification, sample uncertainty and guardrails. Links to separate journey/UX tasks.

Replaced fictional AI product abilities and forecasts with an evidence-to-review workflow, deterministic versus model distinction, input privacy and verification, and separate AI-search observation task.
Preserved the working local HTML checker and disclosures. Added crawlable links to all six interpretation/workflow siblings and activated the existing table of contents.
Clarified immediate source observations and a concrete noindex follow-up; explains what needs separate indexing evidence.
Clarified browser-local versus remote checks and source versus rendered DOM. Links to JavaScript SEO guidance and a report workflow.
Clarified exported findings versus a complete review; added a missing-title observation, correction and retest example and the completed report route.
Clarified title, canonical and robots interpretation without implying Google status or ranking effects; preserved working checker destination.
Rebuilt a small-site scope and customer-task workflow. Distinguishes HTML checks, Search Console, speed, Business Profile and agreed form tests. Removed invented audit history and outcome claims.

Reviewed existing evidence-led homepage and working destinations. Made the opening proposition explicitly identify AuditWeb and website audits; preserved documented self-audit, real resources and USD pricing.

Reviewed policy and added the actual local checker and consented completion-event behaviour. Corrected the obsolete form-processor reference to the observed Cloudflare endpoints and submitted fields; added persistent cookie controls matching the implementation. Existing legal rights, retention and contact provisions preserved.

Read and retained accurate file inventory, real previews, Markdown/ZIP/PDF routes, reuse permission and September 5 file version. Shared attribution/schema added; no false spreadsheet, scoring or fresh-file claims.
Read and retained subscription confirmation purpose and noindex. Excluded from sitemap; no keyword expansion. Shared site/entity schema applies. Delivery is not verified by this page.

Updated the free-tool description to actual browser-local HTML scope and current editorial date. Preserved the existing refund commitment pending the owner policy clarification; did not invent or silently remove commercial terms.
Removed unverified automatic 24-hour report-delivery promise. Clarified scoping and quote next steps; preserved noindex and utility purpose.

Rebuilt around GA4 configuration, key events, actual event delivery, consent, retention/report distinctions and reconciliation limits. Removed arbitrary tolerance and automatic attribution assumptions.

Retained broad task hierarchy and actual finding example; corrected child-card promises, mandatory security/legal claims, word-count/AI-detector rules, cannibalisation diagnosis, field/lab confusion and vendor superlatives. Added practical AI-search scope and methods link; clarified sampled content-audit deliverables and specialist security scope after independent review.

Rebuilt around traceable referring-page evidence, destination repair and documented link-scheme risk. Corrected disavow criteria, removed language/traffic/authority proxies and causal ranking claims. Preserved historic anchors with accurate headings.

Rebuilt the actual landing-page/form/checkout inspection task separately from CRO measurement. Covers error recovery, reliable completion and truthful decision evidence without invented field penalties or conversion lifts.
Rebuilt hierarchy, typography, brand consistency and responsive checks. Correct WCAG contrast, 320 CSS-pixel reflow and 24-pixel target context; separates visual preference from observed failures.

Rebuilt script ownership, trigger and destination inventory; tests consent states, duplicate event causes and performance rather than script-count heuristics. No universal tag-manager or server-side compliance claims.
Rebuilt task success, errors, recovery and appropriate research methods. Removed universal three-click and fixed-participant claims; includes forms and accessibility boundaries.
Rebuilt broader audience comprehension and journey evidence. Distinguishes observations, interpretations and outcomes, with links to usability, design, CRO and architecture specialists.

Added an entity home explaining offerings, methods, source and date interpretation, owned-site evidence, AI-assisted drafting and corrections. No invented person, office, credential or client evidence.
